_comment: Root GDC projects (gproj ID) whose dependencies are supervised, recursively.
_comment_mission_tests: Supervised addons that run_mission_test.ps1 must not load: Workbench plugins, the dedicated server does not compile the WorkbenchGame module.
_comment_families: Addons made to work together by their authors (name prefixes): conflicts inside one family only are not reported.
_comment_load_order: Load order rule of the server mod lists: terrain, then the mission's own mods, then this GDC sequence, then the mission addon (a GDC_AR_Missions project) last. The game loads the list in order, each mod preceded by its dependencies not loaded yet.

load_order._comment_after_ace: In the resolved load order these must come after ACE All in One and all its modules: then ACE Radio's ActivateVON never bypasses Coalition VON's, and Reforger Lobby's UpdateConsciousness is the one kept. A mission mod listed before GDC Core that brings one of them breaks it.
load_order._comment_core_dependency_order: Pairs [first, second]: in GDC Core's addon.gproj, the first dependency must be listed before the second.
